vision.name: Android 18
vision.text: (Your attacks with "Android" in the title are considered Styled.) [Continuous]: Your Styled attacks cost -2 stages (to a minimum of 0). [Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Search your Life Deck for a card with "Android" in the title and place it into your hand. POWER: Your opponent discards a card from their hand. Search your discard pile for a Styled card or card with "Android" in the title and Rejuvenate it.
vision.note: full-art promo layout; right edge reads HERO -> Main Personality; Trait badges E + R above text box
